name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)

facts_verified_2026-10-24: None verified this session. US series IDs in the catalogue are RECALLED from memory (see id_status).

name: OECD (Data Explorer / SDMX API)
project_role: Primary for UK/FRA/ITA/CAN/DEU and broader OECD; 3rd source for USA/JPN/CHN, 3rd for IND (§7)
access_method: SDMX REST API host https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/ ; CSV/JSON
url_status: API host verified 2026-10-24 (OECD API explainer); Data Explorer URL recalled
facts_verified_2026-10-24: OECD.Stat servers went offline 2024-07-01 and queries to stats.oecd.org no longer work; downloads via browser and API are limited to 60 per hour; dataflow versions may change non-backward-compatibly; example dataflow observed in docs: OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_CLI (Composite Leading Indicators).
caveats: Dataflow IDs for all other indicators are PENDING_VERIFICATION. Batch queries to stay under the hourly limit (Q-15).

name: BIS (Data Portal)
project_role: Last fallback for all countries; native producer of credit/DSR/property/EER series (§7, §25)
access_method: Data Portal; bulk CSV; statistics page https://www.bis.org/statistics/
url_status: verified 2026-10-24 (statistics page; data.bis.org/bulkdownload page listing topics incl. credit, property prices, policy rates)
facts_verified_2026-10-24: Third-party package notes say the old www.bis.org CSV bulk files were discontinued in favour of the data portal (2024). Dataset names verified (BIS listings via third-party tools): Credit to the non-financial sector (TOTAL_CREDIT); Credit-to-GDP gaps (CREDIT_GAP); Debt service ratios for the private non-financial sector (DSR); Property prices: selected series (SELECTED_PP) and long series (LONG_PP); Effective exchange rate indices, monthly (EER); US dollar exchange rates (XRU); Policy rates (CBPOL); Consumer prices. BIS release notes show benchmark revisions (e.g., Germany NFC credit revised; China NFC credit re-estimated Mar 2024).
caveats: Series keys, country coverage and start dates are PENDING_VERIFICATION (Q-16).

name: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE)
access_method: DBIE portal downloads; Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy
url_status: verified 2026-10-24 (RBI press release names data.rbi.org.in as the DBIE portal)
facts_verified_2026-10-24: RBI released the 28th edition of the Handbook (2025-26; 245 tables) on 2026-07-31; the series cover national income, prices, money, banking, markets, public finances, foreign trade and balance of payments, and time series are on DBIE.
caveats: Whether DBIE republishes each MoSPI-compiled series with full history is PENDING_VERIFICATION (Q-10).

name: MoSPI (NSO India)
project_role: India second source (§7): national accounts, IIP, CPI, PLFS
facts_verified_2026-10-24: New national accounts series with base 2022-23 released 2026-02-27 (replacing 2011-12); PLFS revamped from Jan 2025 with monthly bulletins from April 2025 and quarterly rural+urban from Apr-Jun 2025.
caveats: Base-year changes require splicing (Q-07, Q-08, Q-09).

name: BOJ / Japanese official statistics (BOJ, Cabinet Office-ESRI, METI, MIC, MHLW via e-Stat)
access_method: BOJ Time-Series Data Search (API launched 2026-02-18); e-Stat https://www.e-stat.go.jp/en ; ESRI https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/en/sna/menu.html
url_status: BOJ page, BOJ API notice, e-Stat and ESRI pages verified 2026-10-24
facts_verified_2026-10-24: e-Stat SDDS Plus table (fetched 2026-10-24): GDP expenditure approach - Cabinet Office; production index - METI; employment, unemployment and CPI - MIC; wage indices - MHLW; corporate goods price index and money stock - BOJ; government bond yield - JSDA; stock index - Nikkei 225 (private provider); balance of payments and reserves - MOF.
caveats: 'BOJ / official' spans several agencies, and the government bond yield (JSDA) and stock index (Nikkei) come from non-governmental bodies (Q-12).

name: NBS China

caveats: Level index must be constructed from growth rates (Q-11). A third-party vendor listing (CEIC) shows quarterly GDP from Mar 1992: UNVERIFIED at source.
